A1.justification: Both PDFs describe RevisEval and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–P. The additional page in v3 reflects acknowledgements and bibliography reflow, with no missing comparison material.

before.justification: v2 reports original accuracy and correlation results for RevisEval in Section 4, plus supplementary experiments on JudgeBench, RewardBench, GPQA, and Omni in Appendices K–O.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark evaluations in Section 4 and the supplementary experimental results in the appendices.

M1.justification: The revision-and-evaluation procedure, randomized selection of the primary response, classical-metric option, and fine-grained variant in Appendix L are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same training sources and NLG and instruction-following evaluation coverage. JudgeBench, RewardBench, GPQA, and Omni already appear in v2 Appendices K–O.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout, including the reference-free/reference-based methods, specialized judge models in Table 2, and DIV-REF comparison in Appendix M.

E3.justification: The model configurations, training budgets, evaluation samples, preprocessing, metrics, prompts, and reference-aggregation protocols are unchanged in Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The positional-bias, inference-cost, reference-relevance, alternative-revision, and multi-reference analyses are retained unchanged, as are the case studies in Section 5 and Appendix J.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged across the matched tables, figures, and experimental descriptions. No seed information, repeated-run summaries, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, GPT-4 RevisEval retains accuracies of 83.0, 72.9, and 79.0 on MT-Bench, AlpacaFarm, and LLMBar in Table 2; appendix Tables 12–19 also retain their results.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(4), the meta-evaluation formulas in Appendix G, and the revision argument in Appendix P are unchanged. Equation (1) moves across a page break without mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about response-adapted references, improved evaluation, classical metrics, and benefits for weaker LLMs. The added code-availability statement does not alter these scientific contributions.

C2.justification: The reference-relevance explanation, qualifications concerning translation and LLMBar, unsuccessful revision strategies, and discussion of retained errors in Appendix P remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code-availability statement and a GitHub repository link in the abstract, absent from v2. Existing prompts, implementation settings, hyperparameters, and data/model access information remain unchanged; repository contents cannot be assessed from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning, and cited-work list are unchanged. Bibliography reflow introduces no additional references, and the DIV-REF comparison was already present in Appendix M.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short code-availability sentence and an Acknowledgements section identifying funding support. The scientific prose and main-text and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The opening pages and bibliography undergo limited reflow, including moving Equation (1) from page 3 to page 4 and shifting the appendix start by one page. Figures and tables retain their content and design; appendix page bodies are visually identical after excluding page numbers.

improvement.justification: The new implementation link provides a code-access pointer absent from v2, modestly improving reproducibility documentation, while funding acknowledgements add transparency. The scientific content, results, and appendices are unchanged, so the benefit is limited. The PDFs do not establish the linked code's completeness or functionality.
